description: Second-hand homes sold in Norway (broker-confirmed sales registered via FINN.no), number per month

table_or_code: Figur 'Solgte - Registrerte omsetninger, siste måned' + Nøkkeltall 'Antall solgte boliger'
notes: Monthly main reports Jan 2020-Sep 2026 (81 PDFs). Values from the key-figure sentences and from the charts, which show the same calendar month for the previous 4-5 years, so 2016-2019 come from the 2020-2023 reports. Latest vintage used (most recent report showing the month). Cross-vintage spread <= 1.9% (sold/listed); history re-based by Eiendomsverdi in Jan 2024 (new model, volumes got new history), checked consistent. Published the third working day of the following month. Not a full census (broker sales advertised on FINN).

description: Registered sales of dwelling properties with building in free sale, whole country, all dwelling types (title transfers), number per quarter
source: Statistics Norway (SSB) StatBank, PxWebApi v0 json-stat2
notes: Registered (tinglyst) title transfers of freehold dwelling properties with known price; excludes housing co-op (borettslag) shares and leasehold sites. Registration happens around take-over, i.e. close to the move date, 1-3 months after the sale agreement. Last two quarters preliminary. 2026K2 published 2026-08-27 (58 days); with lag 60 the latest quarter is not yet available at the 45-day forecast origin, so the feature uses quarter t-1.

description: Dwellings completed (fullførte boliger), incl. extensions, whole country, number per month
source: Statistics Norway (SSB) StatBank, PxWebApi v0 json-stat2
notes: Building statistics from the cadastre (Matrikkelen). Completion is registered when the municipality issues the completion certificate; registration is often late and lumpy, and recent months are revised up. Latest vintage. 2026M08 published 2026-09-14.

description: Dwellings completed, rolling 12-month sum (derived from new_housing_ssb_compl)
notes: Rolling sum of the last 12 months, smooths the lumpy registration of completions.

description: Dwellings under construction (boliger under arbeid), incl. extensions, whole country, end of month stock
source: Statistics Norway (SSB) StatBank, PxWebApi v0 json-stat2
